analysis.title: ETP Flow Update, EMEA UCITS ETP flows, 23 November 2026
key_insights: UCITS ETP inflows moderated to $14.6B for 12-18 Nov 2026 from $19.5B the prior week. Equity ETPs led at $11.7B (down from $19.2B), fixed income rose to $3.1B from $933m, and commodities stayed negative at -$266m (from -$643m).
Developed market equity ETPs took in $10.8B vs $17.6B prior. Global DM led at $4.8B, North America $4.6B (from $9.0B), Europe $1.7B, and APAC reversed to -$217m.
The US remained the main source of single-country buying at $4.6B vs $9.0B. US Large Cap inflows fell to $3.8B from $6.5B, Mid Caps returned to $60m, and Small Caps reversed to -$116m.
Other DM single countries: Switzerland $162m, Sweden $60m, UK $16m (from $59m), Japan -$58m, Germany -$53m (from -$63m). Eurozone inflows rose to $534m from $425m.
EM equity ETPs attracted $908m vs $1.5B prior. India led at $228m (from $481m), South Korea $86m, China $76m, Taiwan $50m. Latin America outflows were -$27m.
Active equity ETPs attracted $672m vs $990m. Alpha-Seeking took in $519m (CORE $552m), Outcome $151m, and Precision reversed to -$73m.

Sustainable equity ETPs attracted $1.2B vs $1.7B. Global inflows fell to $195m from $1.4B, Europe rose to $360m, and North America returned to $333m. Screened strategies led at $634m while Other Uplift reversed to -$315m.

Sector ETP inflows fell to $195m from $1.7B. Technology ($352m vs $718m) and Financials ($202m vs $1.0B) led. Energy outflows eased to -$188m, and Industrials (-$107m) and Consumer Discretionary (-$75m) saw selling.

Thematic inflows were stable at $129m vs $119m. Robotics & AI led at $123m, Cybersecurity returned to $75m, and Artificial Intelligence took $90m. Fintech was -$30m and Climate Energy slowed to $2m from $104m.

Factor ETPs took $381m vs $672m. Quality led at $431m and Low Vol $178m. Momentum saw the largest selling at -$290m (from -$132m) and Value returned to $28m. Income flows were $332m vs $746m and Alternatives -$82m.
Commodity ETP outflows eased to -$266m from -$643m. Gold outflows narrowed to -$64m from -$418m, Silver inflows rose to $135m, Oil was -$29m, and Other Commodities were -$308m.

Fixed income ETPs took $3.1B vs $933m, with index strategies at $2.9B. Investment Grade led at $1.9B (from $815m) and High Yield rose to $766m. Government returned to $184m while EM debt reversed to -$123m.
USD Investment Grade reversed to $1.3B from -$95m. EUR IG was $617m, USD Government outflows eased to -$80m from -$693m, and Hard EM outflows were -$117m.
Active fixed income returned to $155m inflows from -$263m, driven by Exposure strategies at $112m and Alpha-Seeking at $29m.
Sustainable fixed income ETPs saw outflows of -$343m vs -$20m, led by Government at -$263m and Broad Market at -$142m. High Yield took $92m.
UCITS ETP dollar ADV was $24.4B (1.1x 3m ADV). Equity ADV was $18.4B, fixed income $5.0B, and commodities $1.0B.

sector_views.rationale: Technology led sector ETP buying at $352m, though down from $718m the prior week. This reflects flows, not a bank rating.
Financials took $202m of ETP inflows vs $1.0B the prior week. This reflects flows only.
Energy ETP outflows of -$188m, easing from -$458m. This reflects flows only.

risk_factors: Past flows into ETPs are not a guide to current or future flows.
EM debt reversed to -$123m outflows and sustainable fixed income saw -$343m of outflows.
Small Cap US equity ETPs reversed to -$116m outflows and APAC DM equity to -$217m.
vol_and_positioning: Momentum factor ETPs saw outflows of -$290m vs -$132m prior, while Quality inflows were $431m.
Equity ETP demand moderated to $11.7B from $19.2B, while fixed income inflows rose to $3.1B, a partial rotation toward bonds.
Investment Grade ETPs took $1.9B, more than double the prior $815m, with High Yield at $766m, showing credit demand.
Gold ETP outflows narrowed to -$64m from -$418m while Silver inflows were $135m.

key_data_points.anchor: Overall buying of UCITS ETPs moderated last week, with $14.6B of inflows compared with $19.5B the week prior.
Equity ETPs continued to lead allocations at $11.7B, down from $19.2B
Fixed income ETPs attracted $3.1B overall last week, up from $933m previously
Commodity ETPs recorded outflows of -$266m last week, easing from -$643m previously
Developed market equity ETPs attracted $10.8B last week, down from $17.6B previously.
Emerging market equity ETPs attracted $908m last week, down from $1.5B previously
Momentum experienced the largest selling at -$290m, increasing from -$132m previously.
Investment Grade led buying at $1.9B, more than double the previous week's $815m
UCITS ETPs’ dollar average daily volume (ADV) across all issuers was $24.4B last week (1.1x 3m $ADV).
